name: 28339 · Erwin, NC
findings: ZIP 28339 (Erwin) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28339 (Erwin) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28339 (Erwin) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).
